Коли ставимо at, on та in, чим for відрі: When to use at, on and in, how for differs from since, and where ago goes. Plus until and by, during and while, from ... to: everything you need to say exactly when something happens.

on: дні тижня і дати: on: days of the week and dates

for, since, ago: скільки, з якого часу,: for, since, ago: how long, since when, how long ago

for + проміжок (скільки триває): for two: for + a period (how long it lasts): for two hours. since + a starting point: since 2020, since Monday. Often with the Present Perfect.
проміжок + ago (стоїть після): two days: period + ago (ago comes after): two days ago. The verb is in the Past Simple.
until (till): the action continues up to a moment. by: no later than.
during + іменник: during the lesson. whi: during + noun: during the lesson. while + subject + verb: while I was cooking.

on Monday morning, але in the morning: on Monday morning, but in the morning
Частини дня беруть in: in the morning. А: Parts of the day take in: in the morning. But if a particular day is named, use on: on Monday morning. For night time: at night.
Без прийменника: next, last, this, every: No preposition: next, last, this, every
Перед next, last, this, every, а також п: Don’t use a preposition before next, last, this, every, or before today, tomorrow, yesterday.
for чи since, і де стоїть ago: for or since, and where ago goes
